categories.main_business_segments: The company specializes in the research, development, manufacturing, and sales of semiconductor IC testing and related equipment integration solutions. Its product portfolio includes FT test sorters, SLT test sorters, three-temperature test sorters, Flash/Memory test sorters, COF test sorters, and customized equipment integration solutions. It also provides active temperature control (ATC) systems for semiconductor chip testing environments.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced ATC active temperature control technology featuring instant cooling, instant heating, zoned temperature control, and heat dissipation uniformity to simulate real chip operating environments. It develops high-power and ultra-low temperature products, multi-station temperature control equipment, fine-pitch bonding test fixtures, and integrates AI to enhance production efficiency and user convenience. Manufacturing leverages Taiwan's semiconductor supply chain with localized production in China and the USA subsidiaries.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include global IC design companies, semiconductor packaging and testing firms, and IDM semiconductor manufacturers. The products serve high-end chip testing applications such as HPC, AI, cloud servers, CPUs/GPUs/APUs, automotive, industrial, and consumer electronics. Major sales regions include Taiwan, Asia, and the Americas, with growing demand driven by AI, 5G, automotive electronics, and telecom infrastructure sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in Taiwan, China (with a manufacturing subsidiary in Suzhou), and the USA. Sales are distributed across Taiwan (about 33%), Asia (45%), and the Americas (22%), with ongoing efforts to expand overseas subsidiaries and develop new international markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates in the midstream segment of the semiconductor supply chain, focusing on the manufacturing of IC test sorting equipment and related temperature control systems used in semiconductor packaging and testing processes.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include developing advanced packaging test solutions, enhancing temperature control and visual recognition capabilities, and expanding multi-station and high-power temperature control equipment. R&D emphasizes ultra-low temperature and ultra-high power products, fine-pitch bonding, OpenShort equipment, AI integration, and system integration with proprietary ATC technology. The company plans to increase R&D investment to about 5% of net revenue.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of semiconductor IC test sorting machines, temperature control systems, test fixtures, and customized equipment integration solutions. The company also derives income from after-sales services including maintenance, upgrades, and technical support.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Major global competitors include Cohu and Advantest from Europe, the USA, and Japan, as well as Chinese firms like Changchuan Technology and Jinhaitong. The company differentiates itself through strong R&D capabilities, extensive patent portfolio, high customization flexibility, and localized manufacturing and service support, securing approximately 32% market share in the global test sorting equipment segment.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In the latest fiscal year, the company reported consolidated revenue of approximately NT$14 billion, a 47.45% increase year-over-year, with net profit after tax of about NT$5.3 billion, up 72.3%. The company maintains a strong financial structure with growing assets and equity, steady cash flow from operations, and ongoing capital expenditures to expand production capacity.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company offers highly customized, integrated semiconductor IC test sorting solutions with superior temperature control precision via its proprietary ATC system. It supports a wide temperature range (-70°C to 175°C) and high-pressure testing capabilities, meeting stringent reliability requirements for advanced semiconductor packaging. Its close collaboration with global semiconductor leaders, strong patent portfolio, and localized global service network provide competitive advantages in quality, innovation, and customer responsiveness.
